original_text.raw_value: To a solution of 1,3,9-ene-allene-yne 1 (0.3 mmol) in DCE (3 mL) was added gold(I) complex C (14 mg, 15 μmol, 5 mol-%) and the reaction mixture was stirred at room temperature for 12 h. Upon completion, the solvent was removed under reduced pressure and the residue was purified by flash column chromatography on silica gel (eluent: petroleum ether/Et2O = 100:1 to 10:1).
